recipe.visualDefinition: A grid-based typographic composition that mimics the structure of the American flag using repeated phrases. The top section features a black header with arched text and a central eagle emblem, while the main body uses alternating rows of solid and outlined block text in a red, white, and blue palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Text-as-pattern mimicking flag stripes and canton
Alternating solid and hollow glyph weights for rhythmic texture
Arched header text framing a central illustrative icon
Strict vertical alignment creating a three-column grid
coreInvariants: Red, white, and blue color scheme
Black header bar at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main text grid occupies 85% of the frame, acting as the primary subject through repetition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black header bar with the eagle emblem provides a heavy visual anchor at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top header downward, scanning the repetitive rows like reading a flag from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the white background functions as the 'white stripes' of the flag between the letters.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background acting as the base canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep teal-blue and vibrant red for the primary text blocks.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for the top header and thin outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-contrast, high-saturation primary colors against a neutral background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has very short horizontal curves
The 'R' has a straight diagonal leg starting from the mid-point
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, condensed sans-serif for the body grid paired with a classic slab serif for the header.

preserve: Condensed nature of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, flat-terminal aesthetic of the main grid.
Approximates the slab-serif style used in the arched header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical layout with a solid black bar at the top containing a light blue woodcut-style eagle with wings spread. Below the bar, create a white background divided into a three-column grid.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using an extra-condensed bold sans-serif, fill the grid with repeated text. The top-left quadrant should be teal-blue. The rest of the grid should alternate between solid red and thin black outlines on every other row, maintaining strict vertical columns.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly aligned in three vertical columns?
Do the rows alternate between solid color and outline?
Is the top header text arched over the eagle?
Is the color palette strictly teal, red, black, and white?

adjustableVariables: Number of rows in the grid
Specific shade of teal vs navy blue
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping or touching the edges.
Check that the 'outline' rows have no internal fill.
Verify the eagle emblem is centered and does not touch the arched text.
Confirm the teal color is restricted to the top-left section of the grid.
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a grid of [Repeated Phrase] using an extra-condensed sans-serif. Set the top-left section in [Color A], and the remaining grid in alternating rows of solid [Color B] and [Color C] outlines. Top the composition with a black header containing an arched [Secondary Phrase] and a central [Icon].
